description: Tool to request a ticket for creating a Google Analytics account. Use when you need to initiate the account creation flow that requires user acceptance of Terms of Service.

inputSchema.description: Request model for provisioning an account ticket.

account.description: Required. Account details including display name and region code.

displayName.description: Required. Human-readable display name for the account to be created.
displayName.title: Display Name

regionCode.description: Required. Country of business. Must be a valid Unicode CLDR region code (e.g., 'US', 'GB', 'CA').
regionCode.title: Region Code

account.title: Account

redirectUri.description: Required. Redirect URI where the user will be sent after accepting Terms of Service. Must be configured in Cloud Console as a Redirect URI.
redirectUri.title: Redirect Uri

inputSchema.title: ProvisionAccountTicketRequest

name: provision_account_ticket

ProvisionAccountTicketResponse.description: Response model for provisioning an account ticket.

accountTicketId.description: The account ticket ID to be passed in the Terms of Service link.
accountTicketId.title: Account Ticket Id

ProvisionAccountTicketResponse.title: ProvisionAccountTicketResponse
